# FsLangMCP — Full LLM Context

FsLangMCP is an MCP stdio server that gives AI coding agents semantic access to F# projects through the F# Compiler Service (FCS) and FsAutoComplete (FSAC). It is designed to replace text-only navigation with compiler-resolved definitions, references, member call sites, record-field usage, diagnostics, refactoring previews, and project structure.

Canonical documentation: https://neftedollar.com/FsLangMCP/
Repository: https://github.com/Neftedollar/FsLangMCP
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/FsLangMcp/

## Author

- [Roman Melnikov (Neftedollar)](https://neftedollar.com/)

## Install

```bash
dotnet tool install -g FsLangMcp
fslangmcp --bootstrap-tools
```

Bootstrap installs or downgrades FSAC, Ionide.ProjInfo, and Fantomas to the exact versions reviewed for the installed FsLangMCP release. It also creates the `dotnet-fantomas` alias required by FSAC formatting.

## MCP configuration

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "fslangmcp": { "command": "fslangmcp" }
  }
}
```

The server can also preload a project with `fslangmcp --project /absolute/path/to/App.fsproj`. Without that option, call `set_project` once at the beginning of the session.

## Core semantic loop

1. `set_project` binds a `.fsproj`, `.sln`, `.slnx`, or project directory and reports LSP, project-options, and symbol-index readiness.
2. `find` resolves definitions, references, member call sites, record-field sites, and positions across the requested scope.
3. `check` returns one `clean`, `errors`, or `unknown` verdict for a file, project, workspace, or snippet.

Use `find` and `check` as the primary entry points. The remaining tools provide file and project outlines, compile-order inspection, symbol information, diagnostics and code actions, rename previews, refactor impact, dead-code scans, test discovery, formatting, and runtime health.

## Search completeness

`find` separates two kinds of completeness:

- `coverage.complete=true` means every requested project was analyzed.
- `resolution.complete=true` means the current response contains the complete site set from offset zero.

A paginated or capped response is not exhaustive even when the project sweep completed. Follow `nextCursor` while `truncated=true` and reconcile collected sites with `totalEstimate.sites`.

An incomplete zero is reported as indeterminate rather than a confident absence. Inspect the per-project ledger and any FSAC fallback state before treating a miss as proof that a symbol does not exist.

## Check boundary

A `clean` result covers the compiler options represented by the current FCS/check profile. It does not prove that every build configuration is clean; optimized Release compilation can expose configuration-specific diagnostics. Before merge or release, run:

```bash
dotnet build -c Release --warnaserror
```

## Agent integration

Repository integration guide: https://github.com/Neftedollar/FsLangMCP/blob/main/AGENT_INTEGRATION.md

For semantic questions about existing F# source, prefer FsLangMCP over grep. Text search remains appropriate for non-F# configuration and documentation files.
